title: Google Ads Keywords for Accountants: Lists and Negatives

facts.fact: The page is dated October 22, 2026 and is authored by Mirza Lacevic, CEO and Google Ads Strategist at Clickem.
According to the page, a responsive search ad takes up to 15 headlines, each up to 30 characters.
facts.quote: A responsive search ad takes up to 15 headlines of 30 characters each

facts.fact: According to the page, Google's help documentation says negative keywords do not match close variants, so plurals and misspellings of each negative must be added manually.
facts.quote: Google’s own help says negative keywords don’t match close variants

facts.fact: According to the page, the Uniform Accountancy Act, a model law that state accountancy laws largely follow, reserves the titles "certified public accountant" and "CPA" for licensees.
facts.quote: reserves the titles “certified public accountant” and “CPA” for licensees

facts.fact: According to the page, the Uniform Accountancy Act bars firms without a CPA firm permit from providing attest services.
facts.quote: bars firms without a CPA firm permit from providing attest services
